about: Mix-and-match sections for restaurant homepages, from 14 designer references (Pinterest/Dribbble) in this folder (1–15.webp; 11 is an app dashboard, not used). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS from different references. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg (scripts/crop-sections.py). Photos of food, the room and people carry these designs: always use the lead's real photos first, then restaurant stock photos.

styles.name: Noir fine dining
styles.fits: fine dining steak sushi french italian cocktail bar tasting upscale grill modern elegant evening
styles.character: Near-black canvas, one warm accent, a high-contrast serif for headlines, soft dark cards (radius 16), pill buttons with a round arrow chip. Dramatic food photography on black. (Refs 1 Savorelle, 14 La Table Éternelle, 10 Divino.)
styles.fonts: Playfair Display (400/500/600, italic for one accent word) + Inter (300/400/500)

styles.name: Rosso — Italian elegance
styles.fits: italian trattoria pasta pizza wine steakhouse french classic heritage family private dining events catering
styles.character: Deep oxblood red blocks alternating with warm cream and near-black photo bands; everything UPPERCASE in a light high-contrast serif, tiny tracked eyebrows, small square red buttons with ↗. Editorial and restrained. (Ref 2 Enzo.)

styles.name: Crème bistro
styles.fits: bistro cafe brasserie brunch bakery family restaurant mediterranean asian sushi fusion modern casual warm neighbourhood
styles.character: Warm cream paper background, deep espresso-brown ink, one red/terracotta accent, a big editorial serif for headlines, outlined pill chips as eyebrows, thin 1px borders, generous air. Warm and welcoming. (Refs 12 Drizzle, 6 Bamzi, 7 Kado, 5 Lunar.)
styles.fonts: Instrument Serif (400, italic accents) + DM Sans (400/500/600)

styles.name: Street food pop
styles.fits: burger pizza kebab fries fast food takeaway snack chicken tacos street food food truck delivery casual young fun
styles.character: Loud, playful and appetising: chunky condensed display type in caps, a saturated 3-colour palette (deep green, mustard yellow, tomato red) on cream, food cut-outs breaking out of shapes, rotating sticker badges, scrolling word marquees, scalloped/cloud edges, thick outlines. (Refs 4 Bunbite, 13 Chompo, 15 CookBook, 3 Foody, 8 Panpie, 9 Bites.)
styles.fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (700/800, condensed feel via tight tracking) + Inter (400/500/600)

sections.spec: Minimal header (wordmark left, centred nav, accent pill 'Order/Reserve' with arrow chip right). Split hero: LEFT a 3-line serif headline with the last line in the accent colour (a hand-drawn arrow doodle pointing at the dish), short paragraph, pill button; RIGHT a large round plate/dish cut-out on the dark background. A translucent dark card overlapping the middle lists 3 highlights (icon + title + one line).

Full-bleed dark photo of the dining room (warm pendant light). Thin header over it: small wordmark left, tiny tracked uppercase nav centre, 'make a reservation' text link + small solid accent 'order/book' button right. Centred 2-line UPPERCASE light-serif title, two small buttons (solid accent + text link) under it. Lots of dark negative space.

Dark band hero: header with nav in a thin outlined box and a small accent button; centred 2-line serif headline, one-line subline, small square accent button. A large top-down dish photo (cut-out) sits centred at the band's bottom edge, half over the dark band and half over the white section below. Botanical leaf silhouettes in the dark corners.

Cream page. Header: nav split around a centred wordmark with thin vertical dividers between items. Small outlined pill chip, then a HUGE centred 2-line serif headline. Below it a full-width photo of the room/food; a round accent 'Reserve a table ↓' badge overlaps the photo's top edge in the centre.

Solid deep-green hero with a faint food-doodle pattern. Giant 2-line UPPERCASE outlined/filled display title centred; a hand-held hero food cut-out rising from a cream cloud/scalloped shape into the title; a rotating round sticker badge ('Reserve a table ↗'). A yellow marquee band of bold words (★ separated) runs across the bottom.

Full-bleed moody photo (candle-lit table/service). Script wordmark left, spaced uppercase nav right. Headline block on the right: large sans with ONE phrase in an italic script/serif, 4–5 lines. Bottom-left: award/anniversary badges (only real ones); bottom-right: accent pill 'Reserve a table' + chef avatar/signature.
Full-bleed close-up food photo with dark gradient; small header with a yellow pill CTA. Centred 2-line CONDENSED UPPERCASE headline, a 2-line uppercase subline, a small white outlined button.

Three-panel mosaic hero with rounded outer corners: left panel solid brand colour with pattern + food cut-out + serif headline + pill button; centre a tall photo of people cooking/eating; right panel bright accent colour with a second dish cut-out, short headline and outlined button.

Split band in the accent (oxblood) colour: left half a tiny eyebrow + 3-line UPPERCASE serif statement at the top and a small paragraph + 'Discover full story ↗' link at the bottom; right half (a shade darker) a ring/collage of 10–12 small food & guest photos arranged in a circle.

White section: a top-down dish cut-out on a plate left (leaves peeking out); right: small accent icon eyebrow, 2-line serif heading, two short paragraphs, a small dark square 'Food menu' button + phone number with icon.

Two-column intro: left an outlined chip 'Know about us', a 3-line serif statement (40px), accent pill button + 3 overlapping customer avatars with 'satisfied customers' text; right a short tagline top and a rounded photo of guests at a table.

Centred manifesto: a small circular script monogram/badge, then a 5–6 line centred paragraph in a larger serif (22–26px), a thin vertical rule with a dot below; a huge faint script letter as background watermark (aria-hidden).

Cream section: tiny label top-left, big CONDENSED UPPERCASE 3-line statement indented to the right half with a paragraph and outlined button; underneath, a full-width strip of 7 equal portrait photos (food, room, cocktails) edge to edge.

Dark: left a big 2-line serif heading, paragraph, a 2×3 grid of accent round icons + short labels (online orders, reservations, chefs…) and a pill button; right two stacked rounded photos (a dish and a smiling server) overlapping each other.

Alternating two-column menu blocks: block 1 = small icon eyebrow + serif category heading + 4 dishes (serif name left, price right, one-line ingredients below, 1px divider) beside a tall photo; block 2 mirrored. Real dishes and prices only.

Full-bleed dim photo band; centred eyebrow + 2-line UPPERCASE serif heading; 3 small cream cards side by side (category name in accent serif caps + 2-line description), then a 'View the menus ↗' link.

Heading row: 2-line serif heading left, short paragraph right. A carousel of dark rounded cards where the round dish cut-out overflows the card's top edge; dish name centred, price left + heart icon right, accent 'Order/Details' pill + rating; arrow controls below.

Centred bold heading + one line; a stack of full-width category rows (icon + UPPERCASE category + arrow), the open one in the accent/yellow colour revealing a photo card on the left and a price list on the right.
Light: centred serif heading, a row of small tab pills (starters / mains / desserts / wine), a clean price list (name left, price right, hairline dividers) beside a rounded food photo.
Near-black band: centred condensed UPPERCASE 2-line heading; 4 dark photo cards in a row, each with the dish name in small caps on top, price bottom-left and a small arrow square bottom-right.

Beige band with a faint line-drawn food illustration: centred icon eyebrow + 2-line serif heading; 3 white cards each with a round dish photo on top, small accent label, serif category name and 'Our menu' link; below, a giant serif sentence scrolling as a marquee.

Category row: a tall bordered card listing sub-items (1. 2. 3.) on the left, then a big serif heading with a line-drawn food icon and 3 category cards with small icons — the middle one filled dark with light text.
Split: condensed UPPERCASE heading + short text + small button on the left, a 2×2 grid of tightly packed dish photos with names and prices on the right.
'Popular dishes' heading left + round prev/next buttons right; 4 white rounded cards with a dish cut-out, name, star rating, one-line description, price and a small outlined button.
Dark band with a faint pattern; small chip + centred serif heading; a row of 6 polaroid-style photo cards, each slightly rotated (±4°) with a caption underneath, overlapping edge to edge.
A full-bleed strip of 6–7 equal-height photos with small gaps (food, room, bar, grill), no text.

Dark wine-coloured band: small eyebrow, centred UPPERCASE serif heading with one word in script, one line of text; an asymmetric photo layout (narrow tall photo + wide photo) with a small slider progress line.
A circular ring of small rounded photos (food, guests, wine) around an empty centre block in the accent colour.
Heading left + paragraph right; 3 dark rounded cards with chef portraits on a textured dark background, names in serif centred below, arrow controls. Only with real team photos.
Dark band split: left a large serif quote in quotation marks + a divider + small role label and name; right a chef/owner photo cut-out standing in front of a photo of the kitchen/bar.
Split: chef photo on the left; right a small ornament eyebrow, 'Meet <chef>' serif heading, a paragraph, a small outlined button and two stat cards (years, awards) — real numbers only.

Cream section: eyebrow + big UPPERCASE heading left, short text + 'Plan your event ↗' link right; 3–4 photo cards in a row (private dining, parties, weddings) with UPPERCASE titles and a 2-line description.
Upcoming events: heading row, 3 tall photo cards with date (accent, small caps), UPPERCASE title, time and a small accent 'Get ticket ↗' button. Only real events.

Split tile: left a soft gradient panel (pink→cream) with condensed UPPERCASE heading, a small dish image and a link; right a photo of the chef plating with an overlaid title, price line and yellow pill 'Reserve a spot'.
Heading left + one line right; 3 dark rounded cards with avatar, name, small role line and the quote in a larger serif; arrow controls. Real reviews from FACTS only.
Chip + 3-line serif heading on the left; 3 review cards on the right, the middle one filled in the dark/accent colour; each with quote, name, city and a small star rating.
Full-width food photo with 2–3 small pastel review cards floating over it at different heights (stars, bold quote title, text, avatar + name).
Centred bold UPPERCASE heading; a pile of 3 rotated review cards (black / accent / black) overlapping in the centre, each with stars and a short quote in caps.

A wide rounded photo panel inside the container; a white rounded form card overlaps its right side: title, divider, selects (location/guests), date + time inputs side by side, a full-width accent pill 'Confirm reservation'. If the lead uses an external booking link, make the button go there.
Split: chip + 3-line serif heading + accent pill button on the left; a 2×2 collage of rounded photos of guests dining on the right.
Full-bleed dim photo of the room; centred UPPERCASE serif 'Reserve your table', one line, small accent button.
Rounded dark textured banner inside the container: huge 2-line serif line left, one sentence and pill button; a big dish cut-out on the right bleeding off the banner.

Rounded brand-colour banner with a doodle pattern; small icon row, eyebrow, centred 2-line serif heading with one word in a bright accent, pill button + round icon button; food cut-outs tucked into the corners.
Soft gradient band: the phrase split around a centred square food photo — 'YOUR TABLE IS' left, 'WAITING FOR YOU' right — in condensed caps; the whole block links to reservations.
A giant single-line serif sentence (≈90px) scrolling slowly across the full width on the beige band (aria-hidden duplicate for the loop, reduced-motion safe).
A bright yellow band with 2px dark borders, scrolling bold UPPERCASE words (dishes / promises) separated by ★.
A large bowl/dish cut-out centred, overlapping from the white section into a dark band; in the dark band: 2-line serif line left, address and phone with accent icons right.

Oxblood block: a big UPPERCASE serif motto bottom-left; right side columns: newsletter line, navigation, an OPENING HOURS table (day — service — hours, right-aligned times) and contact details. Hours from FACTS only.
Dark textured footer: big serif wordmark + tagline + round social buttons left; a links column and a contact column (address, phone, email, hours with icons) right; hairline divider and legal row.
Dark footer: an enormous serif wordmark filling the left half, newsletter sign-up (line input + accent pill) on the right, then link rows.
Cream footer: serif wordmark + tagline left, 'Visit us' (address + opening hours) and two link columns; social links as colourful pill chips; a row of small dish cut-outs.
Light footer: navigation / contact / connect columns and a newsletter line, with the restaurant name as a huge faint script wordmark running along the bottom edge.
